newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Singapore woman and son charged over maid beating.
newsitem.headline: Singapore woman and son charged over maid beating.

text.p: A Singaporean housewife and her young son were charged in court on Thursday with physically abusing their Indonesian maid, a police spokesman said.
He said the 13-year-old boy, who cannot be named, was charged in a juvenile court with 11 offences, including that of causing grevious hurt.
The mother, 38, faces 10 charges, nine of them accusing her of abetting her son. The most serious charge carries a maximum sentence of seven years in jail, a fine and caning.
She is free on bail of Singapore $$50,000 (US$34,000) and is scheduled to face trial on September 18.

The charges were brought after the maid was admitted to hospital with injuries which included swollen legs caused by repeated scalding and various bruises, welts and scars, the Straits Times reported earlier.

The maid, who said she was 15 years old -- a year below the minimum age for foreign domestic servants in Singapore -- and not the 19 stated in her passport, told the newspaper she was beaten constantly after starting work three months ago.
